name: Additive hyperkalemia risk
actions: Review potassium-related risk factors and concurrent medications.
Monitor serum potassium when clinically appropriate.
Use additional caution in patients with kidney disease, diabetes, dehydration, or other hyperkalemia risk factors.

rationale: Both drugs can contribute to hyperkalemia risk.
Combined effects may increase the likelihood of clinically important potassium elevation.

explanation_template: {A_name} and {B_name} both contribute hyperkalemia risk. Combined use may increase potassium-related risk and may warrant patient-specific monitoring (educational).

references.citation: PD stacking: overlapping hyperkalemia risk may increase potassium-related adverse effects.
